text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon is looking a bit down, so I go and check on her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your concern, Master. I have been worried about abnormalities on my skin.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, it is not a problem. This can be solved by changing out my skin parts.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. That was a "robot joke," if you will.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I attempted to assuage your concerns with a joke, but I failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Currently detecting a shift in status to despair. I have determined that the cause is rough skin.
Unfortunately, it looks like her skin troubles are affecting more than just her skin.
